learningObjective: Set up Backup reports with Log Analytics, and set up and read Azure Monitor alerts for Backup and Site Recovery.
engineer: Reports, step 1: add a diagnostic setting on each vault that sends backup data to a Log Analytics workspace, in resource-specific mode (tables such as AddonAzureBackupJobs and CoreAzureBackup). Use Azure Policy to do this for every vault.
Reports, step 2: open Backup reports in Business continuity center (or in the vault). Tabs: Summary; Backup items; Usage; Jobs; Policies; Optimize.
Reports, timing: the first data can take up to 24 hours to appear.

Built-in alerts: Azure Monitor raises Backup alerts automatically, for example failed backup jobs, or security events such as backup data being soft-deleted. The old classic backup alerts are replaced.
Getting told about alerts: built-in alerts don't email anyone by themselves. Use an alert processing rule to send them to an action group.
Custom alerts: write log search alerts on the backup tables for anything else.
Site Recovery: its health and job alerts also come through Azure Monitor alerts.
Backup jobs page in the vault: shows each job's status, error codes and suggested fixes, live.

example.title: A weekly compliance check
body: An Azure Policy adds diagnostic settings to every vault, sending data to law-backup. The weekly Backup report shows 98.7% of jobs succeeded. The two failures were sent straight away to the backup team's action group by an alert processing rule.

architectureDecisions: Deploy diagnostic settings with Azure Policy: so no vault is missed.
One workspace for backup reports: across all subscriptions.

misconceptions.myth: Backup reports work with no setup.
misconceptions.reality: No. Each vault needs a diagnostic setting that sends data to Log Analytics.
No. Send them to an action group with an alert processing rule.

comparisons.difference: Shows jobs live. Reports show trends across many vaults.

troubleshooting.cause: No diagnostic settings, the wrong workspace, or the data hasn't arrived yet.
troubleshooting.fix: Set up resource-specific diagnostic settings, and wait up to 24 hours.

troubleshooting.symptom: Nobody is told when backups fail.
troubleshooting.cause: The built-in alerts aren't sent anywhere.
troubleshooting.fix: Create an alert processing rule with an action group.

configuration.permissions: Monitoring Contributor (alerts, diagnostic settings) or Backup Contributor (vaults, policies)
